k_clmax.what: section clmax at stall Re, SU2 RANS-SA / XFOIL

k_cd_profile.what: section cd at cl 0.5, cruise Re, SU2 RANS-SA (fully turbulent) / XFOIL
k_cd_profile.invalid_reason: fully turbulent RANS-SA vs XFOIL with transition: not the same section cd; ratio reported, not applied

k_EI.what: effective bending stiffness ratio = tip deflection beam(Phase 3 EI) / FEM

k_GJ.what: effective torsional stiffness ratio = tip twist beam(Phase 3 GJ) / FEM

k_sigma_cover.what: upper-cover stringer σ at ultimate, bay 1 (y = 1.70 m)

lambda_buckling.what: linear buckling eigenvalue at ultimate load (Phase 3 sized to 1.0)

k_flutter.what: flutter speed FEM+DLM p-k (g = 0.03, min sym/antisym) / Phase 3 strip V_F

note: ratios L3/L1-L2 of the same design; applied only if listed in assumptions.calibration.apply
